from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document."""
    doc_label: str | None = Field(description="The identifier of the document (e.g., '判决文书 1')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) stated in the document")
    case_title: str | None = Field(description="The formal case title if distinguishable from the label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
